verses.text: Lut a.s kept warning his people not to commit indecent acts of homosexuality. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 10)
The people denied him and Allah saved Lut and his family except for his wife, and rained upon them stones, so everyone was killed. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 10)

The angels came to Lut (a.s) (in the form of beautiful young men). Lut (a.s) became upset about them, for he felt helpless to offer them protection against his nation’s many violent and homosexual men. (Surah Hud : Section 7)
When the people came to his home demanding to hand over the guests, Lut (a.s) offered his daughters in marriage to them, instead of handing over the guests. (Surah Hud : Section 7)
But the people were bent upon satisfying their lust with men and Lut (a.s) asked: “Is there not even one good man among you!”. (Surah Hud : Section 7)

The messengers then revealed to Lut that they were sent from Allah, and advised Lut to get out of the town, while part of the night remains and to take his family, except for his wife. (Surah Hud : Section 7)
The whole city was turned upside down and there rained on them brimstone of baked clay, layer upon layer specially marked by your Rabb. (Surah Hud : Section 7)

Mention of the incident when the same messengers came to the family of Lut a.s. They informed to Lut a.s about the scourge that will fall upon his people, and asked him to depart with his family during a part of the night. (Surah Al-Hijr : Section 5)
The people of the town (who were steeped in acts of homosexuality), came rejoicing at the news of the young men’s arrival. (Surah Al-Hijr : Section 5)

Lut a.s pleaded to them that they were his guests, but still the people demanded the young men to be handed over. Lut a.s then offered his daughters in marriage to the people. (Surah Al-Hijr : Section 5)

Those people were madly blundering in their intoxication of lust. So the mighty blast overtook them at sunrise and Allah turned the town upside down, and rained down on them brimstones of baked clay. (Surah Al-Hijr : Section 5)
Allah delivered Ibraheem (a.s) and his nephew Lut (a.s), and directed them to a land (i.e Syria), which Allah had blessed for all the people of the world. (Surah Al-Anbiya : Section 5)

Mention of the people of Lut (a.s). Lut (a.s) asked them to fear Allah and warned them: “Will you fornicate with males from among the creatures of the worlds, and leave those whom your Rabb has created for you to be your mates? Nay! You are a people who have transgressed all limits”. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 9)

The people threatened Lut (a.s) that they would expel him and Lut prayed: “O my Rabb! Deliver me and my family from their wicked deeds.” So Allah delivered him and his family, except an old woman who was left among those who remained behind. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 9)

Then Allah utterly destroyed the rest with rains of brimstones. Surely, in this story there is a great lesson, but most of these people do not learn and become believers. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 9)

Reminder about the people of Lut (a.s). The people were steeped in ignorance, committing acts of indecency (with their homosexual behavior). Allah delivered Lut and his family except his wife, and sent a shower of brimstones that destroyed them all. (Surah An-Naml : Section 4)

Lut (a.s) pleaded to his people not to commit such sexual misconduct as no one in the worlds has ever attempted before (i.e. homosexuality). His people had no answer except to say: “Bring us the scourge of Allah if you are truthful”. (Surah AlAnkabut : Section 3)

Allah delivered Lut (a.s) and his whole family, except for an old woman who was among those who remained behind. You pass by their ruins morning and night. Will you not use your common sense? (Surah As-Saffat : Section 4)

Another example are the people of Lut who disbelieved the warning (of their Prophet). Allah let loose on them a stonecharged tornado which spared none except Lut (a.s) and his household (i.e his two daughters). (Surah Al-Qamar :Section 2)
Allah has set an example to the unbelievers in the wife of Nuh (a.s) and the wife of Lut (a.s). (Surah At-Tahreem : Section 2)

They were married to two of Allah’s righteous servants, but they betrayed them in their religion. In no way could their husbands protect them from Allah. Both of them were told: “Enter the fire, along with those who enter it”. (Surah At-Tahreem : Section 2)
